raw: {"analysis":"CST correctly serializes fraud team sign-off before code implementation, which is the safest approach for a non-idempotent payment system where the safety criteria must be defined first. NLV allows Lane A (implementation) to start immediately in parallel with Lane B (fraud validation), which risks building retry logic before the safety spec is agreed upon. Both responses handle the constraints well (transaction_validator immutability, GateKeeper approvals, CI cost control, Gold immutability), but CST's sequencing is more appropriate for the risk profile described.","verdict":"CST"}
